name: Dronabinol
indications_original:
Dronabinol capsules are indicated in adults for the treatment of:
                  
                     
                        •anorexia associated with weight loss in patients with Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS).
                     
                        • nausea and vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy in patients who have failed to respond adequately to conventional antiemetic treatments.
contraindications_original: Anorexia Associated with Weight Loss in Adult Patients with AIDS ( 2.1 ): • The recommended adult starting dosage is 2.5 mg orally twice daily, one hour before lunch and dinner. • See the full prescribing information for dosage titration to manage adverse reactions and to achieve desired therapeutic effect. Nausea and Vomiting Associated with Chemotherapy in Adult Patients Who Failed Conventional Antiemetics ( 2.2 ): • The recommended starting dosage is 5 mg/m 2 , administered 1 to 3 hours prior to the administration of chemotherapy, then every 2 to 4 hours after chemotherapy, for a total of 4 to 6 doses per day. Administer the first dose on an empty stomach at least 30 minutes prior to eating; subsequent doses can be taken without regard to meals. • See the full prescribing information for dosage titration to manage adverse reactions and to achieve desired therapeutic effect.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Dronabinol Capsules, USP
                  2.5 mg white capsules (Identified M2).
                  Cartons of 100 capsules (10 capsules each blister pack x 10), NDC 0904-7144-61 
                  5 mg dark brown capsules (Identified M5).
                  Cartons of 30 capsules (10 capsules each blister pack x 3), NDC 0904-7145-04 
                  WARNING: These Unit Dose packages are not child resistant and are Intended for Institutional Use Only. Keep this and all drugs out of the reach of children.
                  
                  
                     Storage Conditions
                  
                  Dronabinol capsules should be packaged in a well-closed container and stored in a cool environment between 8° and 15°C (46° and 59°F) and alternatively could be stored in a refrigerator. Protect from freezing.
adverseReactions_original: Dronabinol capsules are contraindicated in patients with a history of a hypersensitivity reaction to dronabinol or sesame oil. Reported hypersensitivity reactions to dronabinol capsules include lip swelling, hives, disseminated rash, oral lesions, skin burning, flushing and throat tightness [see Adverse Reactions (6.2)].
